metadata.description: Claude Code mods of a DafkeDD project: the checking agents at a glance, the handoff offer, screen share, Anthropic's Replay Theater and /mods.

plugins.name: checks-desk
plugins.description: The checking agents and the to-do list at a glance: a line above the prompt and a pane per check (/checks).

plugins.name: handoff-offer
plugins.description: When the chat gets full, offers to write the handoff and go on in a fresh chat.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: A demo aid that hides e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and the names you add on screen (/screen-share); Claude keeps the real data.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Anthropic's sample (Apache 2.0): step through the file edits of the last turn (/replay).

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: Shows the mods of this project, which are on, and how to switch them (/mods).
